description: This file defines functions and types for resolving agent delivery plans and outbound targets in an outbound messaging system, including handling message channels, turn sources, and target resolution logic.

methods.name: resolveAgentDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Resolves the delivery plan for an agent, determining the channel, target, and related parameters based on input session and message details.

methods.name: resolveAgentOutboundTarget
methods.description: Resolves the outbound target for a given delivery plan, considering configuration and target mode.
